latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the OpenClaw Default Agent Backstory skill.
- Enables creation and refinement of a default agent identity for the OpenClaw platform.
- Provides interactive interview flow to gather user input and seed agent context files (`AGENTS.md`, `SOUL.md`, `TOOLS.md`, `IDENTITY.md`, `USER.md`, `HEARTBEAT.md`, `BOOTSTRAP.md`).
- Supports two modes: full workspace bootstrap and identity refresh.
- Ensures practical, stable defaults for daily agent use and memory management.
- Adheres to clear rules for user interaction, content preservation, and documentation.
